note: Gradient-inversion figures for the explainer. Paths are relative to this file. The explainer selects the undefended arm by noise_multiplier == 0 and the defended arm by noise_multiplier > 0, so replacing the images is a file copy plus an edit here — no code change. While `placeholder` is true the panels are generated by scripts/build_inversion_placeholders.py and are not results.
